# Foxdusk AIOS

> Foxdusk AIOS is a video-editing kit that runs on your own computer (Mac or Windows). It turns a raw talking-head recording into a finished video: free on-device transcription, automatic removal of silences and retakes, branded burned-in captions, and motion graphics built with Claude Code or OpenAI Codex. One-time payment, no subscription. Made in Malaysia by Foxdusk, a division of Trulab Production Sdn. Bhd.

## What it does

- Foxdusk Studio: a step-by-step app in the browser, in English or Bahasa Melayu. No coding needed for the basic edit.
- Transcription: free and word by word, made on the user's computer. ElevenLabs is optional.
- Remove dead air: shortens long silent pauses to a natural breath.
- Fix mistakes: finds stutters, false starts and retakes; the user approves each cut.
- Captions: burned into the video in the user's own brand font and colour.
- Motion graphics: titles, callouts and B-roll timed to the words, with Claude Code or OpenAI Codex (14 editing skills, two scene templates, 406 draft cards).
- Also: Reels and YouTube Shorts (9:16), 10–30 second brand showreels, and promo videos made from a website link.

## Who it is for

Creators, coaches, educators, podcasters and small marketing teams who record themselves talking and want a finished, branded video without editing every cut by hand.

## Price and licence

- One-time price, shown on https://www.foxdusk.com/ (currently RM 299, paid in Malaysian ringgit).
- Payment by bank transfer or DuitNow; card and FPX through Stripe when enabled.
- One licence key works on 2 computers. Videos made with it belong to the buyer, including for client work.
- No monthly fee to Foxdusk. Services the buyer chooses to connect (Claude, OpenAI, ElevenLabs) are billed by those providers.

## Requirements

- A Mac or a Windows PC with at least 5 GB free.
- An internet connection (licence check, setup, and Claude Code or Codex work online).
- For motion graphics: a Claude plan or Anthropic API credits for Claude Code, or OpenAI Codex. Transcription, cuts, captions and downloading the video work without either.
- Footage stays on the user's computer unless they choose a cloud service such as ElevenLabs.

## Hookdusk AIOS

Hookdusk AIOS is a second kit from Foxdusk for TikTok, Reels and Shorts content planning with Claude Code or OpenAI Codex. It runs as Hookdusk Studio in the browser on the user's computer.

- Topics: 5 to 15 topic ideas for the user's niche, each scored for hook strength, relevance and ease of filming, or a breakdown and remix of a reference video.
- Hooks: 10 openings from 14 hook formulas, each with a spoken line, on-screen text and an opening visual.
- Scripts: timed beats with on-screen text, visuals and pattern interrupts, plus call to action, caption and hashtags, in BM santai, BM formal, Manglish or English.
- Content council: four fictional advisors score each script and suggest one fix each.
- Price: RM 299 one-time, or RM 399 for a bundle with Foxdusk AIOS. One licence key works on 2 computers.
- Needs a Claude plan or Anthropic API credits for Claude Code, or OpenAI Codex.
